PRIMETIME 2026.title: Primetime
PRIMETIME 2026.description: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history. When a high stakes operation goes fatally wrong, his veneered dream of fame curdles into a nightmare of performative justice.

THE WEIGHT 2026.title: The Weight
THE WEIGHT 2026.description: When Samuel is torn from his daughter and sent to a brutal prison, Warden Clancy offers him a high-stakes proposition: smuggle gold out of a remote mine with a dangerous crew of prisoners and he’ll win his freedom.

THE ONLY LIVING PICKPOCKET IN NEW YORK 2.title: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
THE ONLY LIVING PICKPOCKET IN NEW YORK 2.description: Harry Lehman is an aging pickpocket who plies his trade with ever-diminishing returns in a drastically changed New York. Wallets stuffed with cash have been replaced by easily cancelled credit cards, and Harry struggles to make ends meet as he cares for his disabled wife, Rosie. When he unwittingly purloins and fences a valuable USB stick, Harry finds himself in a race against time to return the loot or face the rage of a vengeful crime family.

YOUR MOTHER YOUR MOTHER YOUR MOTHER 2026.title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
YOUR MOTHER YOUR MOTHER YOUR MOTHER 2026.description: Latif, a devoutly religious hitman, struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him – and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.

SACRIFICE 2026.title: Sacrifice
SACRIFICE 2026.description: During a star-studded charity gala brimming with celebrities, billionaires, and empty speeches, a movie star in the midst of an existential crisis is taken hostage by a radical warrior and her devoted followers. As the night descends into chaos, both an inward journey and an outward adventure ensue, where the line between performance and belief, salvation and sacrifice, begins to blur.

THE MONGOOSE 2026.title: The Mongoose
THE MONGOOSE 2026.description: A falsely accused war hero with nothing to lose leads police on an epic televised cross-country car chase, helped by members of his former Special Forces Army battalion and closely monitored by a fascinated public rooting for his safe getaway.

MASTERPLAN 2026.title: Masterplan
MASTERPLAN 2026.description: When a legendary thief sets his sights on the Mona Lisa, he recruits two young strangers to help him before revealing they are long-lost siblings… and oh yes, by the way, he is their father. Thrown into a chaotic reunion they never asked for, this new family must learn to work together — and try not to kill each other — if they want any chance at pulling off the heist of the century.

THE CAT IN THE HAT 2026.title: The Cat in the Hat
THE CAT IN THE HAT 2026.description: Assigned his toughest mission yet, the Cat must cheer up siblings Gabby and Sebastian as they adjust to life in a new town. Known for pushing boundaries, this agent of chaos must prove himself or risk losing his magical hat forever.

I PLAY ROCKY 2026.title: I Play Rocky
I PLAY ROCKY 2026.description: The electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn't just meant to write Rocky—he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Told "no" at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds.

MADDEN 2026.title: Madden
MADDEN 2026.description: Chronicles John Madden's incredible journey alongside best friend and true original Al Davis—from a Super Bowl-winning partnership with the Raiders, to becoming football’s most recognizable voice, to building the worldwide Madden NFL video game.

PAPER TIGER 2026.title: Paper Tiger
PAPER TIGER 2026.description: Two brothers become entangled in a scheme that turns out to be too good to be true. As they try to navigate their way through the dangerous world of the Russian mafia, family bonds begin to fray with life-altering consequences.

THE RUNNER 2026.title: The Runner
THE RUNNER 2026.description: Maia Marten, a brilliant London lawyer, has her life shattered by a single call on her morning run: her son has been taken. To get him back, she must keep running, obey every ruthless command, and trust no one-each second a test of how far a mother will go to save her child.

WILD HORSE NINE 2026.title: Wild Horse Nine
WILD HORSE NINE 2026.description: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ. Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.

THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOT.title: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOT.description: Eight years after the events of Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood, Cliff Booth returns to a changing Los Angeles. Now working as a fixer in the shadows of the Hollywood studio system, Cliff finds himself entangled in a dangerous web of secrets, crimes and betrayals that will test everything he knows about loyalty and survival.

AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY 2026.title: Avengers: Doomsday
AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY 2026.description: Beloved heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.

DUNE: PART THREE 2026.title: Dune: Part Three
DUNE: PART THREE 2026.description: Nearly two decades after he seized control of the Imperium, Paul Atreides is now a ruthless Emperor, and must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. As enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.

KHAN TUMHARA 2026.title: Khan Tumhara
KHAN TUMHARA 2026.description: A genre blend of action sequences with romance and drama, centering on the character Yusuf Khan, described as navigating power, love and vengeance.

INK 2026.title: Ink
INK 2026.description: A group of misfits and visionaries had an idea for a new kind of news - one that would give the people what they want, and would change the face of the world we live in today.

LA BOLA NEGRA 2026.title: La Bola Negra
LA BOLA NEGRA 2026.description: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.

ICE AGE: BOILING POINT 2027.title: Ice Age: Boiling Point
ICE AGE: BOILING POINT 2027.description: A dinosaur-and-lava-filled madcap adventure takes Manny, Sid, Diego, Ellie, Buck, acorn-obsessed Scrat – this time joined by Baby Scrat and the enormous Jurassic Scrat – and the rest of the herd to visit never before-seen corners of the treacherous Lost World.

GATTO 2027.title: Gatto
GATTO 2027.description: After years of maneuvering the canal-ridden, superstitious city of Venice, Italy, a scrappy black cat named Nero begins to question whether he’s lived the right lives. Indebted to Rocco, a ruthless local feline mob boss, Nero finds himself in a quandary and is forced to forge a truly unexpected friendship that may finally lead him to his purpose — unless Venice gets the better of him first.

THE THOMAS CROWN AFFAIR 2027.title: The Thomas Crown Affair
THE THOMAS CROWN AFFAIR 2027.description: A debonair, adventuresome man believes he has pulled off the perfect multi-million dollar heist, only to match wits with an insurance investigator who will do anything to get her man.

SHREK 5 2027.title: Shrek 5
SHREK 5 2027.description: Shrek and Donkey team up for another whirlwind, big-city adventure, this time in the magical city of Further Further Away.
